title: Inside The Private-Market Divide: EquityZen’s Phil Haslett On AI, SaaS And Secondaries
content: The market for private-company shares has become a much bigger part of the startup ecosystem. In this Crunchbase News Q&A, EquityZen co-founder Phil Haslett discusses why startups are offering employees and investors liquidity earlier, and why secondary prices can be more revealing than headline valuations.
